name: B10-0404/2026 (The Left) – Post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-electoral repression in Zambia and the killing of Mutotwe Kafwaya
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Zambia after the August 2026 elections. It condemns the killing of opposition figure Mutotwe Kafwaya and the arrests of opposition members, journalists and activists. It asks Zambia to investigate the killing, release people held without charge, stop misusing security and treason laws, and keep courts open. It also asks the European Union to raise these concerns directly with Zambia and to make sure its investments there do not excuse repression.

- The Parliament only states positions and makes requests; no law or funding decision changes.
- It affects Zambia's government, detained opposition members and the European Union's dealings with Zambia.
- Next, the resolution is sent to European Union bodies and Zambia's authorities; follow-up depends on them.
